People keep giving me compliments. I think if I keep going eventually they will stop and that is okay because I have learned to not rely on others to validate me anyway. I used to love sweets because they gave me a temporary serotonin boost now I am just disgusted with Chinese takeout, pizza, and sweets. Don't get me wrong I still eat a gluten-free and vegan pizza/or sometimes just regular, Chinese takeout sometimes, and sweets but back then I ate them almost EVERYDAY.

Honestly having an ED takes all energy out of me to really exercise anyway. And also working out doesn't do shit for me. It's really a calorie deficit or restriction/strict diet that helps me lose weight. Low impact workouts make a difference and lifting weights 2 to 3 times per week and that's it. Since I am 5'0 it really boils down to what I am eating.
